newsitem.title: UK: Three Valleys Water to make payment to households.
newsitem.headline: Three Valleys Water to make payment to households.

text.p: Three Valleys Water said on Thursday it would pay 10 stg directly to households affected by a recent notice to boil drinking water.
Acting in conjunction with health authorities, Three Valleys Water on Tuesday lifted the notice to customers in West Hertfordshire, Barnet and parts of North London to boil drinking water.
Households in the Luton area who were affected by a much shorter notice will receive five stg.
The company said in a statement that the payments reflect costs to customers and inconvenience caused.
Three Valleys Water is a unit of Cie Gnrale des Eaux of France.
